findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_alternative_mcp_servers, watch_server, unwatch_server, check_api_status, list_providers, get_digest, check_merchant · Private data: get_api_key, watch_server, list_watches, unwatch_server, batch_check_mcp_servers, score_spend, spendgate_get_api_key, check_merchant, paycheck_get_api_key · Public sink: get_api_key, watch_server, list_watches, unwatch_server, get_digest, check_merchant · Destructive: unwatch_server, get_quota, paycheck_get_quota.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_alternative_mcp_servers, watch_server, unwatch_server, check_api_status, list_providers, get_digest, check_merchant · Private data: get_api_key, watch_server, list_watches, unwatch_server, batch_check_mcp_servers, score_spend, spendgate_get_api_key, check_merchant, paycheck_get_api_key · Public sink: get_api_key, watch_server, list_watches, unwatch_server, get_digest, check_merchant · Destructive: unwatch_server, get_quota, paycheck_get_quota

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
